Payout of 4 August is short ₹2,220.99.
The bank credited ₹8,85,707.63 against an expected ₹8,87,928.62. 18 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000008 of ₹2,220.99, issued 10 July against payment pay_000061. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000008 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000008 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
